_meta.identityConfidenceReason: Confirmed via operator's own site (adventurebritain.com), trading name of Call of the Wild Ltd, registered office Ty Anturiaeth, 83 Church Road, Seven Sisters, Neath SA10 9DT, phone 01639 700388. Corroborated by TripAdvisor listing (Adventure Britain, Swansea, g186466-d1936565, 128 reviews, ranked #2 of 7 Classes & Workshops in Swansea).
redFlags: Operator does NOT serve Snowdonia. Its own homepage and activities page state operations take place in 'the natural playground of the Brecon Beacons (Bannau Brycheiniog) and the Gower Coast' (South Wales only), plus Afan Forest (South Wales) for mountain biking. No Snowdonia/North Wales presence found anywhere on the operator's site or in third-party listings. It should be removed from any Snowdonia combo/slice page and regions set to brecon-beacons + gower only.

Google rating/review count could not be independently verified — no accessible Google Maps listing data found via search (results blocked/redirected). Seed figure of ~4.5/600+ is unconfirmed; leaving googleRating/reviewCount null rather than guessing. TripAdvisor confirms 128 reviews and a #2/7 local ranking but exact star score wasn't retrievable (page returned 403 to automated fetch).

Contact email info@adventurebritain.com from seed could not be confirmed on-site; the site's contact page only publishes a phone number and postal address, no email address was visible on the pages crawled. Treat email as unverified.

Business trades as 'Adventure Britain' but is legally 'Call of the Wild Ltd' — some accommodation partners (e.g. 'Merlin's') referenced in customer reviews are third-party lodging, not part of Adventure Britain itself.

proposedOperatorData.description:
Adventure Britain is the trading name of Call of the Wild Ltd, a South Wales adventure activity operator based in Seven Sisters, Neath. It runs outdoor pursuits across the Brecon Beacons (Bannau Brycheiniog) National Park and the Gower Coast, including canyoning, caving, rock climbing, gorge walking, canoeing, quad biking and clay pigeon shooting, with mountain biking based in Afan Forest and on the southern edge of the Brecon Beacons.

The company mainly serves activity weekends, stag and hen groups, corporate team-building days and family activity days, often bundling activities with third-party accommodation partners. It holds Adventure Activities Licensing Service (AALS) licensing, Institute of Leadership and Management accreditation, and City & Guilds accreditation, and has won awards including Welsh Small Business of the Year.

Adventure Britain operates exclusively in South Wales (Brecon Beacons and Gower/Swansea Bay area) and does not run activities in Snowdonia/North Wales.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: One of the longer-established South Wales multi-activity operators, combining canyoning/gorge walking/caving with packaged stag, hen, family and corporate weekends across Brecon Beacons and Gower.
